import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='viridis', 
                             s=df['Physical Activity Level']/2, alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Stress Level\n(Size = Physical Activity)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# 2. Distribution of Sleep Duration by Occupation
top_occupations = df['Occupation'].value_counts().nlargest(8).index
df_top_occ = df[df['Occupation'].isin(top_occupations)]
sns.boxplot(data=df_top_occ, x='Occupation', y='Sleep Duration', ax=axes[0, 1], palette='Set2')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Occupation\n(Top 8 Occupations)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Average Metrics by BMI Category
bmi_metrics = df.groupby('BMI Category').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Physical Activity Level': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean'
}).reset_index()

x = np.arange(len(bmi_metrics))
width = 0.2
metrics = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level']
colors = ['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c', '#d62728']

for i, (metric, color) in enumerate(zip(metrics, colors)):
    values = bmi_metrics[metric].values
    if metric == 'Stress Level':
        values = -values  # Invert for better visualization
    axes[0, 2].bar(x + i*width - width*1.5, values, width, label=metric, color=color, alpha=0.8)

axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Average Value', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Average Health Metrics by BMI Category\n(Stress Level inverted for comparison)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].set_xticks(x)
axes[0, 2].set_xticklabels(bmi_metrics['BMI Category'])
axes[0, 2].legend(fontsize=9)

# 4. Correlation Heatmap
correlation_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                    'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[correlation_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=0.5, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, ax=axes[1, 0])
axes[1, 0].set_title('Correlation Matrix of Key Metrics', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Daily Steps vs Physical Activity by Gender
scatter2 = axes[1, 1].scatter(df['Daily Steps'], df['Physical Activity Level'], 
                              c=df['Age'], cmap='plasma', alpha=0.6, s=50)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Daily Steps vs Physical Activity by Age', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
cbar2 = plt.colorbar(scatter2, ax=axes[1, 1])
cbar2.set_label('Age', fontsize=10)

# 6. Sleep Quality Distribution by Stress Level and Gender
df['Stress_Group'] = pd.cut(df['Stress Level'], bins=[0, 3, 6, 10], labels=['Low', 'Medium', 'High'])
stress_gender_data = df.groupby(['Stress_Group', 'Gender'])['Quality of Sleep'].mean().unstack()
stress_gender_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 2], color=['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e'], alpha=0.8)
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Stress Level Group', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Average Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Average Sleep Quality by Stress Level and Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 2].legend(title='Gender', fontsize=9)
axes[1, 2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# Adjust layout
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
